review.note: The pinned v0.29.0 README supplies a main-agent orchestration route and a bundled Claude Code skill. The shipped skill provides workspace/default-session dispatch and chat inspection and messages through product-owned IPC tools. This is the product-supplied coordinator role allowed by the directory definition, scoped to the installed skill and running desktop/CLI; it does not establish provider-native subagent ownership or an executed test.
